_readme: Services page copy, plus one record per service under `items` — each carrying its icon, discipline and related equipment alongside its wording.

meta.title: Services
meta.description: Hydraulic equipment repair, refrigeration and air-conditioning, preventive maintenance, motor rewinding, cooling tower servicing, fabrication and roll-up doors — from one shop in {city}.

hero.title: Repair, installation and maintenance under one roof

list.title: {count} service lines, one accountable team
list.description: Open any service for what it covers, the equipment it applies to, and the clients we have delivered it for.

approach.title: The same approach on every job

assessed.title: Assessed before it is quoted
assessed.description: A check-up confirms the actual fault first, so the quotation covers what the unit needs rather than a standard package.

location.title: On your site or in our shop
location.description: Whichever costs you less downtime. Equipment that cannot be moved is worked on where it stands.

repairFirst.title: Repair before replacement
repairFirst.description: Rewinding, resealing and rebounding keep serviceable equipment out of the scrap bin — and off your capital budget.

cta.title: Describe the fault — we will tell you what it needs
cta.description: Send the equipment, the symptom and the site. If we need to inspect it before quoting, we will arrange a check-up rather than guess at a price.

coverage.title: What this service covers
coverage.body: Work is carried out at your site where the equipment cannot easily be moved, and in the {city} workshop where a strip-down is the safer option. In either case the scope is confirmed by a check-up before anything is committed to a quotation.

photos.title: This work, in our hands
photos.description: Photographs from our own projects — not stock imagery.

projects.title: Clients this service has been delivered for
projects.description: Taken from the vendor project record in our company profile.

cta.title: Need {service}?
cta.description: Tell us the equipment, the fault and the site. We will arrange a check-up and quote what the job actually needs.

hydraulic-equipment-repair.title: Hydraulic Equipment Repair
hydraulic-equipment-repair.summary: Forklifts, hand pallet trucks, stackers, jacks and presses put back to work.
hydraulic-equipment-repair.description: The core of the shop. Our technicians repair, supply and install various forklift and hand pallet truck brands — from a leaking cylinder to a full mechanical rehabilitation. Units can be worked on at your site or brought into the shop, whichever keeps your operation moving.
benefits: Electric, diesel and gas forklift repair
Hand pallet truck, stacker and crocodile jack repair

refrigeration-airconditioning.title: Refrigeration & Air-Conditioning
refrigeration-airconditioning.summary: Low temperature, industrial, domestic, transport and vehicle cooling systems.
refrigeration-airconditioning.description: We cover the full range of cooling work, from a walk-in freezer to a package-type air-conditioning unit or a refrigerated van. Repairs, transfers and complete installations are all handled by the same team.
benefits: Industrial refrigeration — centralised and package-type ACU
Domestic refrigeration — fridges, freezers and others
Transport refrigeration — refrigerated vans and reefer units

installation-maintenance.title: Installation & Preventive Maintenance
installation-maintenance.summary: Scheduled upkeep for cooling systems, motors, pumps and dock equipment.
installation-maintenance.description: Planned maintenance keeps small faults from becoming shutdowns. We install refrigeration and air-conditioning systems, induction and DC motors and submersible pumps, then keep them on a maintenance schedule agreed with your team.
benefits: Induction motor, DC motor and submersible pump servicing
Dock leveller and roll-up door maintenance

motor-rewinding.title: Motor Rewinding & Reconditioning
motor-rewinding.summary: Rewinding and reconditioning rather than replacing a failed motor.
motor-rewinding.description: A rewound motor is usually back in service for a fraction of the cost of a new unit, which is part of how the shop keeps repairs environmentally friendly. We handle induction motors, DC motors, submersible pump motors and compressor motors.

cooling-tower-servicing.title: Cooling Tower Servicing
cooling-tower-servicing.summary: General servicing through to complete cooling tower rehabilitation.
cooling-tower-servicing.description: Scale, rust and algae quietly cost you cooling capacity. We service cooling tower units end to end, and where a tower is too far gone for cleaning alone we carry out a complete rehabilitation.

fabrication-doors.title: Fabrication & Roll-Up Doors
fabrication-doors.summary: Aluminium and stainless fabrication, plus motorised and manual roll-up doors.
fabrication-doors.description: In-house fabrication in aluminium, stainless steel and other materials — from replacement parts and company logo signage to minor construction repairs. We also supply and install motorised and manual roll-up doors.
benefits: Aluminium, stainless steel and other fabrication
Supply and installation of motorised roll-up doors
Minor construction repairs and logo fabrication

parts-supply.title: Spare Parts & Consumables
parts-supply.summary: Refrigerants, wheels, batteries and replacement parts, supplied on request.
parts-supply.description: We supply the consumables and spare parts that go with the work — refrigerants, hydraulic components, polyurethane wheels, industrial batteries and chargers — so a repair is not held up waiting on a separate supplier.
benefits: Forklift and hand pallet truck parts
